concept: Thunderbolt 5 Bus Latency and Bandwidth Scaling Limit
summary: Source-anchored research for Thunderbolt 5 Bus Latency and Bandwidth Scaling Limit. Run status: COMPLETED.

facts.text: Thunderbolt 5 encapsulates PCIe Gen 4 x4 protocol packets with maximum unidirectional real-world payload throughput bounded at approximately 7.0 GB/s. (high confidence)

Attempting to stream model parameters across Thunderbolt 5 during autoregressive generation introduces severe PCIe latency stalls that limit generation to sub-1 token/sec for weights exceeding VRAM. (high confidence)
